summary: DURABLE-REGISTRY SIGNER CROSS-RECORD CONSISTENCY AND TOCTOU REPAIR IMPLEMENTED. The Model-B signing consumer now fails before hardware interaction on binding/signer principal or provider conflicts and compares a complete immutable authority-state snapshot before publication. B-149O.20L.7O.2F.3-1/2 are repaired but not closed; independent verification is required. BF-1/BF-2 remain independently confirmed closed at the implementation boundary. HSCE-001 is minimally clarified to v1.3 by revising only HSCE-REQ-080/083. No real provisioning, trust enrollment, HMIC action, certification, activation, Dell, runtime, PIV, or Stream-B action occurred.
